patchwork_device.doc: Base class for all Patchwork devices.

perception_trigger_device.doc: Specialized trigger_base_device that will fire output events based on line of sight between agent s and the device.

events.AgentLooksAtDeviceEvent: Signaled when an agent has direct line of sight to this device. Sends the agent that has seen this device.
events.AgentLooksAwayFromDeviceEvent: Signaled when an agent has lost direct line of sight to this device. Sends the agent that has lost sight of this device.
events.DeviceLosesSightOfAgentEvent: Signaled when this device loses direct line of sight to an agent . Sends the agent this device has lost sight of.
events.DeviceSeesAgentEvent: Signaled when this device has direct line of sight to an agent . Sends the agent seen by this device.

physics_boulder_device.doc: Physics boulder that can be dislodged and damage agent s, vehicles, creatures, and structures.

events.BalancedBoulderDestroyedEvent: Signaled when the balanced boulder is destroyed.
events.BalancedBoulderSpawnedEvent: Signaled when the balanced boulder is spawned on the base.
events.BaseDestroyedEvent: Signaled when the base of the boulder is destroyed.
events.RollingBoulderDestroyedEvent: Signaled when the rolling boulder is destroyed.

physics_object_base_device.doc: Base class for various physics-based gameplay elements (e.g.

physics_tree_device.doc: Physics tree that can be chopped down, and damage players, vehicles, creatures, and structures.

events.LogDestroyedEvent: Signaled when the log created by a tree is destroyed.
events.StumpDestroyedEvent: Signaled when the stump created by a tree is destroyed.
events.TreeKnockedDownEvent: Signaled when a tree has taken enough damage to be knocked down.
events.TreeSpawnedEvent: Signaled when a tree is spawned.

pinball_bumper_device.doc: A triggered bumper that can knock players back, damage them, and award points.

events.ActivatedEvent: Signaled when this device is activated by an agent . Sends the agent that activated this device.

pinball_flipper_device.doc: Used to move, damage, and give scores to players that interact with it.

events.ActivatedEvent: Signaled when this device is activated by an agent . Sends the agent that activated this device.

player_checkpoint_device.doc: Used to set an agent 's spawn point when activated.

events.FirstActivationEvent: Signaled when this device is first activated by any agent . Sends the agent that activated this device.
events.FirstActivationPerAgentEvent: Signaled each time a new agent activates this device. Sends the agent that activated this device.

player_counter_device.doc: Used to track and react to how many players are in a particular area, and optionally display that information in game.

events.CountFailsEvent: Signaled when the player count does not match Target Player Count . The frequency of evaluation against Target Player Count can be controlled through the device settings.
events.CountSucceedsEvent: Signaled when the player count matches Target Player Count . The frequency of evaluation against Target Player Count can be controlled through the device settings.
events.CountedEvent: Signaled when a valid player enters the zone and is counted. The frequency of evaluation against the Target Player Count can be controlled through the device settings. Sends the agent that is now being counted.
events.RemovedEvent: Signaled when a player is no longer counted by this device, such as when they leave the zone, leave the game, or are assigned to a different team or class. Sends the agent that is no longer being counted.

player_marker_device.doc: Used to mark an agent 's position on the minimap and configure the information shown for marked agent s.

events.FirstItemValueChangedEvent: Signaled when the first item type monitored on marked agents has changed. Sends the marked agent .
events.FirstItemValueReachedEvent: Signaled when a marked agent meets the quantity condition for the first monitored item type (e.g. Fewer Than, Equal To, More Than X). Sends the marked agent .
events.SecondItemValueChangedEvent: Signaled when the second item type monitored on marked agents has changed. Sends the marked agent .
events.SecondItemValueReachedEvent: Signaled when a marked agent meets the quantity condition for the second monitored item type (e.g. Fewer Than, Equal To, More Than X). Sends the marked agent .

player_movement_settings_device.doc: Used to update the player character's movement settings on different movement mode.

player_reference_device.doc: Used to relay agent statistics to other devices and agent s.

events.ActivatedEvent: Signaled when this device is activated. Sends the agent stored in the device.
events.AgentReplacedEvent: Signaled when the agent tracked by this device is replaced. Sends the new agent stored in the device.
events.AgentUpdateFailsEvent: Signaled when the agent tracked by this fails to be updated. Sends the agent that attempted to be stored in this device.
events.AgentUpdatedEvent: Signaled when the agent tracked by this device is updated. Sends the new agent stored in the device.
events.TrackedStatChangedEvent: Signaled when a stat tracked by this device is updated. Sends the agent stored in the device.

player_spawner_device.doc: Used to spawn an agent on an island.

events.SpawnedEvent: Signaled when an agent is spawned from this device. Sends the agent that spawned.

popup_dialog_device.doc: Used to create HUD text boxes that give players information, and allows responses to be customized to player choices.

events.DismissedEvent: Signaled when this device is dismissed by an agent . Sends the agent who dismissed the popup.
events.RespondingButtonEvent: Signaled when Button on this device is pushed by an agent . Sends the agent that pushed the button. Sends the int index of the button that was clicked.
events.ShownEvent: Signaled when this device is shown to an agent . Sends the agent looking at the popup.
events.TimeOutEvent: Signaled when this device times out while an agent is looking at it. Sends the agent who was looking at the popup.

post_process_device.doc: Used to apply Post Process Effects to players through the creative device rather than a Post Process Volume.

events.BlendingInCompleteEvent: Signaled when a blend in event has finished. Sends the agent that used this device.
events.BlendingOutCompleteEvent: Signaled when a blend out event has finished. Sends the agent that used this device.

powerup_device.doc: Base class for various powerup devices offering common events like ItemPickedUpEvent .

events.ItemPickedUpEvent: Signaled when the powerup is picked up by an agent . Sends the agent that picked up the powerup.

progress_based_mesh_device.doc: This device is used to associate changes in progression with a mesh transition.

events.EmptyEvent: This event is fired whenever 'CurrentProgress' reaches 0.
events.FillEvent: This event is fired whenever 'CurrentProgress' reaches the 'ProgressTarget'.
events.ProgressChangeEvent: This event is fired whenever 'CurrentProgress' value gets changed, whether through direct modification, or as a result of the Progress or Regress state.

prop_manipulator_device.doc: Used to manipulate the properties of one or more props in a specified area (e.g.

events.DamagedEvent: Signaled when props affected by this device are damaged. Sends the agent that damaged the prop.
events.DestroyedEvent: Signaled when props affected by this device are destroyed. Sends the agent that destroyed the prop.
events.HarvestingEvent: Signaled when prop resource nodes affected by this device are harvested. Sends the agent that harvested resources from the prop.
events.ResourceDepletionEvent: Signaled when prop resource nodes affected by this device are completely depleted of energy. Sends the agent that depleted the prop's energy.

prop_mover_device.doc: Used to move around a building or prop, and customize responses to various collision event types.

events.AIHitEvent: Signaled when the prop hits a creature, animal, or NPC.
events.AgentHitEvent: Signaled when the prop hits an agent . Sends the agent hit by the prop.
events.BeganEvent: Signaled when the prop movement begins.
events.DisabledEvent: Signaled when this device is disabled.
events.EnabledEvent: Signaled when this device is enabled.
events.EndedEvent: Signaled when the prop movement ends.
events.FinishedEvent: Signaled when the prop reaches its destination.
events.MovementModeChangedEvent: Signaled when the prop changes its direction.
events.PropHitEvent: Signaled when the prop hits another prop.

prop_o_matic_manager_device.doc: Allows customization of the Prop-o-Matic weapon functions and how the game reacts to players using it.

events.BeginEnteringDisguiseEvent: Signaled when an agent begins entering a disguise. Sends the agent that began entering the disguise.
events.ExitingDisguiseEvent: Signaled when an agent exits a disguise. Sends the agent that exited the disguise.
events.FinishEnteringDisguiseEvent: Signaled when an agent finishes entering a disguise. Sends the agent that finished entering the disguise.
events.PingAllPlayerPropsEvent: Signaled when all player props have been pinged.
events.PingPlayerPropEvent: Signaled when a player prop has been pinged. Sends the agent that was pinged.

prop_spawner_base_device.doc: Base class for devices that spawn a prop object.

pulse_trigger_device.doc: A device used to damage players who collide with it.

race_checkpoint_device.doc: Used in tandem with race_manager_device to define the route players must traverse.

events.CheckpointBecomesCurrentEvent: Signaled when this checkpoint becomes the current checkpoint for agent . Sends the agent who is now targeting this checkpoint.
events.CheckpointBecomesCurrentForTheFirstTimeE: Signaled when this checkpoint becomes the next checkpoint that agent s need to pass for the first time. Sends the first agent who is now targeting this checkpoint.
events.CheckpointCompletedEvent: Signaled when an agent passes this checkpoint. Sends the agent that passed this checkpoint.

race_manager_device.doc: Used with the race_checkpoint_device to create more advanced racing modes.

events.FirstLapCompletedEvent: Signaled when an agent completes their first lap. Sends the agent that finished the lap.
events.LapCompletedEvent: Signaled when an agent completes a lap. Sends the agent that finished the lap.
events.RaceBeganEvent: Signaled when the race begins. Sends the agent that started the race.
events.RaceCompletedEvent: Signaled when an agent finishes the race. Sends the agent that finished the race.

radio_device.doc: Used to play curated music from the device or one or more registered agent s.

real_time_clock_device.doc: Used to trigger in game events based on real world time.

events.DurationElapsedEvent: Signaled when the optional second Duration time has been reached.
events.EnablingAfterTimeReachedEvent: Signaled when this device is enabled after the target time has been reached.
events.EnablingBeforeTimeReachedEvent: Signaled when this device is enabled before the target time has been reached.
events.TimeReachedEvent: Signaled when the target time is reached.

reboot_van_device.doc: Allow players to bring eliminated teammates back into the game.

events.RebootCardPurchaseEvent: Triggers when a player purchases a Reboot Card. agent is the player that purchased the Reboot Card.
events.RebootEvent: Triggers when Reboot Van has finished rebooting a set of players. agent is the player that started the reboot.
events.RechargeCompleteEvent: Triggers when Reboot Van has finished recharging. agent is the last interacting player.

rift_point_volume_device.doc: The Rift Point volume is used to interface with and manage the Rift Point item, and provides an area that enables players to plant the item to create search and destroy style gameplay.

events.DefuseCancelEvent: Sends an event when defusing the Rift Point is canceled, passing in the defusing agent .
events.DefuseEvent: Sends an event when the Rift Point is defused, passing in the defusing agent .
events.DefuseStartEvent: Sends an event when defusing the Rift Point is started, passing in the defusing agent .
events.DetonateEvent: Sends an event when the Rift Point detonates, passing in the planting agent .
events.OnAgentEntered: Sends an event when an agent enters the volume.
events.OnAgentExited: Sends an event when an agent exits the volume.
events.PlantCancelEvent: Sends an event when planting the Rift Point is canceled, passing in the planting agent .
events.PlantEvent: Sends an event when the Rift Point is planted, passing in the planting agent .
events.PlantStartEvent: Sends an event when planting the Rift Point is started, passing in the planting agent .

rng_device.doc: Used to generate random numbers between a minimum and maximum value.

events.LoseEvent: Signaled when the generated number < Winning Value .
events.RolledMaxEvent: Signaled when the generated number = maximum.
events.RolledMinEvent: Signaled when the generated number = minimum.
events.WinEvent: Signaled when the generated number >= Winning Value .

roly_poly_spawner_device.doc: Device for spawning a Roly Poly.

events.DismountEvent: Signaled when an 'agent' exits a spawned Roly Poly. Sends the 'agent' that exited the Roly Poly.
events.FleeEvent: Signaled when a spawned Roly Poly flees.
events.FrightenEvent: Signaled when an 'agent' causes the spawned Roly Poly to curl up and hide.
events.RideEvent: Signaled when an 'agent' enters a spawned Roly Poly. Sends the 'agent' that entered the Roly Poly.
events.SootheEvent: Signaled when an 'agent' causes the spawned Roly Poly to open up after being scared.
events.SpawnEvent: Signaled when a Roly Poly is spawned or respawned by this device.

round_settings_device.doc: Used to customize gameplay for any round-based game.

events.RoundBeginEvent: Signaled when a game round starts.

score_manager_device.doc: Used to manipulate scores using in-experience triggers.

events.MaxTriggersEvent: Signaled when the this device reaches its maximum number of triggers as defined by Times Can Trigger . Sends the agent who last triggered the device.
events.ScoreOutputEvent: Signaled when the this device awards points to an agent . Sends the agent who received the points.

scout_spire_device.doc: A boss-like environmental encounter that will attack players with different abilities.

events.ActivateEvent: Triggers when the Spire becomes activated from players entering the Activation Distance
events.BeginChargeLaserEvent: Triggers when the Spire begins its laser attack
events.DeactivateEvent: Triggers when the Spire becomes deactivated, either from players leaving the Activation Distance
events.DestroyEvent: Triggers when the Spire is destroyed from damage or events Includes the agent that destroyed it, if any.
events.EndChargeAndFireLaserEvent: Triggers when the Spire shoots its laser attack. Triggers once, even if it shoots at multiple targets

sentry_device.doc: Generates an AI bot that spawns in a location and usually attacks players when they come in range.

events.AlertedEvent: Signaled when the sentry is alerted to an agent . Sends the agent who alerted the sentry.
events.AttackingEvent: Signaled when a sentry attacks an agent . Sends the agent who is being attacked.
events.EliminatedEvent: Signaled when a sentry is eliminated. Sends the agent that eliminated the sentry. If the sentry was eliminated by a non-agent then false is returned.
events.EliminatingACreatureEvent: Signaled when the sentry eliminates a creature.
events.EliminatingAgentEvent: Signaled when a sentry eliminates an agent . Sends the agent who was eliminated by the sentry.
events.EntersAlertCooldownEvent: Signaled when the sentry enters the alert state.
events.ExitsAlertEvent: Signaled when the sentry exists the alert state.

service_station_device.doc: A one stop automated refueling and repairing station for your vehicles.

events.VehicleEnteredEvent: Fires when a vehicle enters the service station, returns the vehicle that entered.
events.VehicleExitedEvent: Fires when a vehicle leaves the service station, returns the vehicle that exited.
events.VehicleFuelingBeginEvent: Fires on the first tick of a vehicle refueling, returns the refueled vehicle.
events.VehicleFuelingEndEvent: Fires when a vehicle is at full fuel, returns the refueled vehicle.
events.VehicleRepairBeginEvent: Fires when a vehicle starts repairing, returns the repaired vehicle.
events.VehicleRepairEndEvent: Fires when a vehicle is at full health, returns the repaired vehicle.

shooting_range_target_device.doc: A single customizable pop up target that can be hit by agent s to trigger various events.

events.BullseyeHitEvent: Signaled when the target is hit in the bullseye area.
events.HitEvent: Signaled when the target is hit by an agent .
events.HopDownEvent: Signaled when the target moves down slightly, making it harder to hit.
events.HopUpEvent: Signaled when the target moves up slightly, making it harder to hit.
events.KnockdownEvent: Signaled when the target takes enough damage to get knocked down.
events.PopDownEvent: Signaled when the target moves from standing upright to laying flat.
events.PopUpEvent: Signaled when the target moves from laying flat to standing upright.

shooting_range_target_track_device.doc: A set of customizable pop up targets that can be hit by players to trigger various events.

events.BullseyeHitEvent: Signaled when target is hit in the bullseye area.
events.HitEvent: Signaled when the target is hit by a player.
events.HopDownEvent: Signaled when the target moves down slightly, making it harder to hit.
events.HopUpEvent: Signaled when the target moves up slightly, making it harder to hit.
events.KnockdownEvent: Signaled when the target is hit by a player.
events.PopDownEvent: Signaled when the target moves from standing upright to laying flat.
events.PopUpEvent: Signaled when the target moves from laying flat to standing upright.

signal_remote_manager_device.doc: Used to trigger a custom response to a Primary or Secondary signal, sent by a Signal Remote item.

events.PrimarySignalEvent: Signaled when a player has triggered the Primary signal using a Signal Remote item. Sends the agent that triggered the signal.
events.SecondarySignalEvent: Signaled when a player has triggered the Secondary signal using a Signal Remote item. Sends the agent that triggered the signal.

skilled_interaction_device.doc: Used to create a minigame which expects specific input timing from the player.

events.AdvanceAgentFromQueueEvent: Signaled when the agent moves from the queue into interacting. An agent enters the queue if BeginInteract is called for them but there is no room for them to begin an interaction given the current configuration. This event will fire when an agent who is waiting in that queue advances from it and begins an interaction, removing it from the queue
events.BadInputTriggeredEvent: Signaled when the agent provides a bad input. Bad input occurs when input is provided while the scrubber is outside the Good Zone . Sends the agent that provided the input. Sends the float position of the meter scrubber from 0.0 to 1.0 .
events.EmptyQueueEvent: Fired when the queue empties of all queued agents. The queue has to have at least one agent in it for this to fire. If BeginInteraction is called and a queue is not created, then this event will not be triggered.
events.GoodInputTriggeredEvent: Signaled when the agent provides a good input. Good input occurs when input is provided while the scrubber is within the Good Zone (excluding the Perfect Zone ). Sends the agent that provided the input. Sends the float position of the meter scrubber from 0.0 to 1.0 .
events.InteractionCanceledEvent: Signaled when the interaction is interrupted. The interaction can be interrupted in several ways. If the participating agent is eliminated or enters a downed state. If Deactivate is called while the interaction is in progress. If Disable* is called while the interaction is in progress.
events.InteractionFailedEvent: Signaled when the agent fails the interaction. The interaction can be failed in several ways If the number of bad inputs reaches the Failure Limit . If the interaction has an Interaction Time Limit that expires.
events.InteractionStartedEvent: Signaled when the agent starts an interaction. Input is the agent which started interacting with the device.
events.InteractionSucceededEvent: Signaled when the agent succeeds at the interaction. The interaction is completed depending on the device's configuration. Once the device's Success Target is reached. Upon a perfect input if using Instant Success Perfect Behavior .
events.PerfectInputTriggeredEvent: Signaled when the agent provides a perfect input. Perfect input occurs when input is provided while the scrubber is within the device's Perfect Zone . Sends the agent that provided the input. Sends the float position of the meter scrubber from 0.0 to 1.0 .
events.QueueAgentEvent: Signaled when the agent is put into the queue but has not started an interaction. If an agent skips the queue and is put directly into interacting, this event is skipped.
events.RemoveAgentFromQueueEvent: Signaled when the agent has been removed from the queue. This can happen in a few ways An agent is removed without advancing into an interaction. If Disable is called while an agent is in the queue. The queue size is shrunk, causing agents to be removed.

skydive_volume_device.doc: Used to create a zone where players are put into a skydive state.

events.AgentEntersEvent: Signaled when an agent enters the volume. Sends the agent that entered the volume.
events.AgentExitsEvent: Signaled when an agent exits the volume. Sends the agent that exited the volume.
events.ZoneEmptiedEvent: Signaled when the zone changes from occupied to empty. Sends the agent that last left the volume.
events.ZoneOccupiedEvent: Signaled when the zone changes from empty to occupied. Sends the agent that entered the volume.

skydome_device.doc: Controls how the sky looks, as well as giving you options for changing the sun, clouds, stars or other objects in the sky above your island.

speaker_device.doc: Output Patchwork audio for players to hear.

spire_spike_device.doc: A Destroyable environment prop that when destroyed, drops loot.

events.DestroyEvent: Triggers when the Spire Spike is destroyed. Includes the agent that destroyed it, if any.
events.KnockbackEvent: Triggers when the Spire Spike does its knockback ability.

stat_creator_device.doc: A device that generates a scoreboard stat that can be used by the game to determine Game End and Round End conditions.

events.LevelChangedEvent: Signaled when the stat changes Level. Sends a tuple of the instigating agent (or false if none) and the new Level.
events.MaximumReachedEvent: Signaled when an agent reaches the maximum stat value. This occurs when the stat reaches Max Value if the device has no levels, or Max Level if that option is set. Sends the agent that caused the stat event that changed the level and the new level as an int .
events.ValueChangedEvent: Signaled when the stat changes Value. Sends a tuple of the instigating agent (or false if none) and the new Value. Value increases to a maximum of Max Value . If the stat has not yet reached Max Level then Value will reset to 0 and Level will increment by 1.

stat_powerup_device.doc: Used to increase or decrease a stat for an agent .

events.ItemPickedUpEvent: Signaled when the powerup is picked up by an agent . Sends the agent that picked up the powerup.

step_modulator_device.doc: Modify a setting on another Patchwork device in steps over time.

storm_controller_device.doc: Base class for various specialized storm devices.

events.PhaseEndedEvent: Signaled when storm resizing ends. Use this with the On Finish Behavior option for better controls.

supply_drop_spawner_device.doc: Used to spawn and configure an aerial supply drop that can provide players with customized weapons/supplies.

events.BalloonPoppedEvent: Signaled when the balloon on the supply crate is popped. Sends the ?agent that popped the balloon. If no agent popped the balloon returns false .
events.DestroyCrateEvent: Signaled when the supply crate is destroyed. Sends the destroying agent . If no agent destroyed the crate then false is returned.
events.LandingEvent: Signaled when the supply crate lands for the first time.
events.OpenedEvent: Signaled when the supply crate is opened. Sends the agent that opened the crate.

support_a_creator_device.doc: DEPRECATED This device is no longer supported.Used to inform players of other content made by a creator using a Support-A-Creator code.

switch_device.doc: Used to allow agents to turn other linked devices on/off or other custom state changes.

events.ClearEvent: Signaled when the persistent data is cleared by the specified agent . Sends the agent that cleared persistent data on the device.
events.IfOffWhenCheckedEvent: Signaled if the switch is off when the state is checked.
events.IfOnWhenCheckedEvent: Signaled if the switch is on when the state is checked.
events.StateChangesEvent: Signaled when the switch state changes.
events.StateLoadEvent: Signaled when the switch state is loaded by the specified agent . Sends the agent that loaded the state on the device.
events.StateSaveEvent: Signaled when the switch state is saved.
events.TurnedOffEvent: Signaled when the switch is turned off by the specified agent . Sends the agent that turned off the device.
events.TurnedOnEvent: Signaled when the switch is turned on by the specified agent . Sends the agent that turned on the device.

sword_in_the_stone_device.doc: Used to place the Infinity Blade on your island.

team_settings_and_inventory_device.doc: Provides team and inventory configurations that go beyond the choices the My Island settings provide.

events.EnemyEliminatedEvent: Signaled when an enemy of Team is eliminated by a team member. Sends the agent team member who eliminated the enemy.
events.TeamMemberEliminatedEvent: Signaled when a member of Team is eliminated. Sends the agent that was eliminated.
events.TeamMemberSpawnedEvent: Signaled when a member of Team is spawned.Sends the agent that has spawned.
events.TeamOutOfRespawnsEvent: Signaled when Team runs out of respawns.

teleporter_device.doc: Customizable rift that allows agent s to move instantly between locations.

events.EnterEvent: Signaled when an agent enters this device. Sends the agent that entered this device.
events.TeleportedEvent: Signaled when an agent emerges from this device. Sends the agent that emerged from this device.

timed_objective_device.doc: Configures game modes where players can start or stop timers to advance gameplay objectives, such as Attack/Defend Bomb objectives.

events.BeganEvent: Signaled when the objective begins. Sends the agent that started the timer.
events.CompletedEvent: Signaled when the objective is completed. Sends the agent that started the timer or completed the timer by calling Complete .
events.EndedEvent: Signaled when the objective ends. Sends the agent that stopped the timer.
events.PausedEvent: Signaled when the objective is paused. Sends the agent that paused the timer.
events.RestartedEvent: Signaled when the objective is restarted. Sends the agent that restarted the timer.
events.ResumedEvent: Signaled when the objective is resumed. Sends the agent that resumed the timer.

timer_device.doc: Provides a way to keep track of the time something has taken, either for scoreboard purposes, or to trigger actions.

events.FailureEvent: Signaled when the timer completes or ends with failure. Sends the agent that activated the timer, if any.
events.StartUrgencyModeEvent: Signaled when the timer enters Urgency Mode . Sends the agent that activated the timer, if any.
events.SuccessEvent: Signaled when the timer completes or ends with success. Sends the agent that activated the timer, if any.

tracker_device.doc: Allows creation and HUD tracking of custom objectives for agent s to complete.

events.CompleteEvent: Signaled when the tracked value reaches GetTarget for an agent . Sends the agent that reached GetTarget for their tracked value.

trick_tile_device.doc: A trap device that destroys the tile it's placed on when activated.

events.ActivatedEvent: Signaled when the tile this device is attached to is removed. This may occur later than TriggeredEvent if Activation Delay is set on the device. Sends the agent that activated this device.
events.TriggeredEvent: Signaled when this device is triggered. Sends the agent that triggered this device.

trigger_base_device.doc: Base class for various specialized trigger devices.

trigger_device.doc: Used to relay events to other linked devices.

events.TriggeredEvent: Signaled when an agent triggers this device. Sends the agent that used this device. Returns false if no agent triggered the action (ex: it was triggered through code).

value_setter_device.doc: Modify a setting on another Patchwork device when triggered.

vehicle_mod_box_spawner_device.doc: Used to spawn customizable boxes containing vehicle mods.

events.BoxDestroyedEvent: Triggers whenever the mod box is destroyed regardless of whether a mod was applied. Returns tuple: 0: The agent that triggered this event, if applicable. 1: The index int of the chosen mod in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1. If Possible Mods is not set to Custom List , int will be -1 .
events.BoxSpawnedEvent: Triggers whenever the mod box spawns. Returns the index int of the chosen mod in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1. If Possible Mods is not set to Custom List , int will be -1 .
events.ModAppliedEvent: Triggers whenever the mod is applied to a vehicle. Returns tuple: 0: The agent driving the vehicle, if applicable. 1: The fort_vehicle the mod applied to. 2: The index int of the chosen mod in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1. If Possible Mods is not set to Custom List , int will be -1 .
events.ModApplyFailedEvent: Triggers whenever the mod fails to apply to a vehicle. Returns tuple: 0: The agent driving the vehicle, if applicable. 1: The fort_vehicle the mod failed to apply to. 2: The index int of the chosen mod in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1. If Possible Mods is not set to Custom List , int will be -1 .
events.ModApplyOverriddenEvent: If ModAppliedEvent is overridden (see SetOverrideModApplyEvent ), breaking a mod box triggers this instead of ModAppliedEvent , ModApplyFailEvent , or NoModEvent . Returns tuple: 0: The agent driving the vehicle, if applicable. 1: The fort_vehicle the mod would attempt to apply to. 2: The index int of the chosen mod in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1. If Possible Mods is not set to Custom List , int will be -1 .
events.NoModEvent: Triggers whenever a No Mod entry from a custom list tries to apply to a vehicle. Returns tuple: 0: The agent driving the vehicle, if applicable. 1: The fort_vehicle that broke the box. 2: The index int of the specific No Mod entry in the device's list, starting with 0 for Custom List Mod 1.

vehicle_spawner_armored_assault_tank_dev.doc: Specialized vehicle_spawner_device that allows an Armored Assault Tank to be configured and spawned.

events.AgentEntersVehicleEvent: Signaled when an agent enters the vehicle. Sends the agent that entered the vehicle.
events.AgentExitsVehicleEvent: Signaled when an agent exits the vehicle. Sends the agent that exited the vehicle.
events.DestroyedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is destroyed.
events.SpawnedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is spawned or respawned by this device. Sends the fort_vehicle who was spawned.
events.VehicleDestroyedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is destroyed. Deprecated, use DestroyedEvent instead.

events.SpawnedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is spawned or respawned by this device. Sends the fort_vehicle who was spawned.
events.VehicleDestroyedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is destroyed. Deprecated, use DestroyedEvent instead.
events.VehicleSpawnedEvent: Signaled when a vehicle is spawned or respawned by this device. Deprecated, use SpawnedEvent instead.

vending_machine_device.doc: Holds and spawns items, with an optional cost for each item.

events.ItemSpawnedEvent: Signaled when an item is spawned from this device. Sends the agent that used this device.

vfx_creator_device.doc: Used to create and customize your own visual effects.

vfx_spawner_device.doc: Used to place visual effects around your island.

events.EffectDisabledEvent: Signaled when the effect is disabled.
events.EffectEnabledEvent: Signaled when the effect is enabled.

video_player_device.doc: Used to display curated videos onto in-game screens or player HUDs.

events.StreamStartedEvent: Signaled when this device becomes the controlling streaming device for the agent .

vine_rail_device.doc: Used to create a customizable vine version of the Grind Rails.

events.EndedGrindingEvent: Signaled when an agent starts grinding on this vine_rail_device .
events.StartedGrindingEvent: Signaled when an agent starts grinding on this vine_rail_device .

visual_effect_powerup_device.doc: Used to trigger a visual effect (a glow or an outline) when agent s pick it up.

events.ItemPickedUpEvent: Signaled when the powerup is picked up by an agent . Sends the agent that picked up the powerup.

volume_device.doc: Used to track when agents enter and exit a volume.

events.AgentEntersEvent: Signaled when an agent enters the device volume.
events.AgentExitsEvent: Signaled when an agent exits the device volume.
events.PropEnterEvent: Signaled when an creative_prop entered the device volume.
events.PropExitEvent: Signaled when an creative_prop exited the device volume.

events.VoteTiedEvent: Triggered when voting ends and at least two options are tied for first place.

water_device.doc: Used to create and manipulate volumes of water where players can swim, fish, or drive boats.

events.AgentEntersWaterEvent: Signaled when an agent enters the water. Sends agent that entered the water.
events.AgentExitsWaterEvent: Signaled when an agent exits the water. Sends agent that exited the water.
events.VerticalEmptyingCompletedEvent: Signals when the water volume is completely empty.
events.VerticalFillingCompletedEvent: Signals when the volume is filled to the water level set in the Default Vertical Water Percentage option.

wildlife_spawner_device.doc: Used to customize the properties of NPCs spawned by this device.

events.DamagedEvent: Signaled when wildlife is damaged. Source is the agent that damaged the wildlife. If the wildlife was damaged by a non-agent then false is returned. Target is the wildlife that was damaged.
events.DismountedEvent: Signaled when an agent dismounts wildlife. Source is the agent that dismounted the wildlife. Target is the wildlife that was dismounted.
events.EliminatedEvent: Signaled when wildlife is eliminated. Source is the agent that eliminated the wildlife. If the wildlife was eliminated by a non-agent, or because the oldest wildlife was eliminated as Spawn function was called after spawn count was exceeded, then Source is 'false'. Target is the wildlife that was eliminated.
events.EliminatingEvent: Signaled when a wildlife eliminates an agent. Source is the wildlife that eliminated the agent. Target is the agent that was eliminated.
events.ForceSpawnedEvent: Signaled when wildlife is force-spawned and causes the oldest wildlife to be eliminated. Sends the agent wildlife that was spawned.
events.RiddenEvent: Signaled when an agent rides wildlife. Source is the agent that started riding the wildlife. Target is the wildlife that was ridden.
events.SomethingIsEatenEvent: Signaled when wildlife eats a pickup such as a Shroom or Meat. Sends the wildlife that ate something.
events.SpawnedEvent: Signaled when this device spawns wildlife. Sends the agent wildlife that was spawned.
events.TamedEvent: Signaled when wildlife is tamed. Source is the agent that tamed the wildlife. Target is the wildlife that was tamed.
events.UntamedEvent: Signaled when wildlife is untamed. Source is the agent that tamed the wildlife. Target is the wildlife that was untamed.

wilds_plant_device.doc: Used to create plants with explosive pods that players can detonate and launch.

events.ExplodeEvent: Triggers whenever the plant or launched projectile explodes. Sends the agent that initially launched the projectile or triggered an immediate explosion. Sends false if no agent is found.
events.LaunchEvent: Triggers whenever the plant launches a projectile. Sends the agent that triggered this event. Sends false if no agent is found.
